title: Big bands, Basie, and bands touring the Gulf South
summary: Big bands had the names and could afford to pay; he mentions Basie and bands working Florida to Mississippi, saying he preferred staying home and jobbing around.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: But most of the bands on the road at that time were the big bands, not the ...

Well I guess they had smaller bands but the big bands had the names there. Well they could afford to pay them. Now it's kind of hard to pay a big band because the price is well. What they do, they still have them, was Basie now, you take the band that Basie's got. It was called Kansas City or something, see? And that was a big band. Basie was a piano player and they said he took the band over. Well they had a whole lot of big bands on the road. I just can't remember all the names, you know. And they were all good.

They had a big band. They used to be on the road right out of here. They worked all in Florida, Alabama, Georgia, all around this area, all through Louisiana, Mississippi, and they had a lot of value. So a lot of fellas, I don't know what kind of money they made, but some of them I never would go nowhere with. I'd sooner stay home and just job around.
